chart.tableFallback: Showing the result as a table
chart.emptyConfig: Configure fields to generate a chart
chart.funnelSummary: {{description}}. First step {{first}}, last step {{last}}, overall conversion {{total}}.

toolbar.unavailableReason: Not compatible with the current result

field.title: Field settings
field.forecastPointsTooltip: Points extrapolated beyond the observed data; 0 means no extrapolation, 90 at most
field.thresholdTooltip: When set, projects when the value will be reached or dropped below and marks the expected date on the chart; leave empty to skip the projection
field.trendLineTooltip: Overlays a regression line across the whole range to show the overall trend

field.applied: Chart settings applied (click “Overwrite save” to persist them to the card)
field.hintDrawer: Closing without applying does not change the current chart.
field.hintLive: Unit changes apply immediately; click “Apply settings” for the other items.
field.splitByUnitHint: Metrics on the {{axis}} use different units; move the differing ones to the other axis

issue.axisSplitSuggested: Metric magnitudes differ by {{ratio}}×; consider moving {{metrics}} to the right axis
issue.noRows: No data for the current conditions
issue.ambiguousRole: Cannot reliably tell whether “{{name}}” is a dimension or a metric. Configure the fields to generate a chart; the raw table is unaffected.
issue.missingTime: Missing time dimension; a line chart cannot be drawn
issue.duplicateKey: Duplicate keys found; no aggregation applied
issue.duplicateKeyColumns: Duplicate keys found ({{columns}}); no aggregation applied
issue.seriesCellCollapsed: An unbound grouping column exists; rows sharing an X value were summed
issue.seriesDimensionUnused: {{count}} grouping column(s) unused; try setting one as the split series
issue.seriesDimensionUnused_one: {{count}} grouping column is unused; try setting it as the split series
issue.seriesDimensionUnused_other: {{count}} grouping columns are unused; try setting one as the split series
issue.seriesLimitExceeded: More than {{max}} series; kept the top {{max}} by total
issue.staleBinding: The saved field binding references a missing column; fell back to auto binding
issue.staleBindingColumns: The saved field binding references missing column(s) ({{columns}}); fell back to auto binding
issue.tooManySeries: Too many series ({{max}} at most); narrow the grouping or switch to a table
issue.tooManyRows: More than 10000 rows returned and the chart is not sampled. Narrow the SQL or the time range
issue.tooManyPoints: Too many data points; narrow the range to draw the chart
issue.tooManyMetrics: Too many metrics ({{max}} at most); select the metrics to chart
issue.negativeValue: Negative values found; the current chart type cannot show them
issue.negativeValueColumns: Negative values found ({{columns}}); the current chart type cannot show them
issue.zeroTotal: The metric total is 0; a composition chart cannot be drawn
issue.nonAdditiveMetric: “{{name}}” is not additive and cannot be used in a pie chart or another composition total
issue.mixedUnits: Metrics on the same axis ({{axis}}) use different units: {{columns}}
issue.unsafeInteger: “{{name}}” exceeds the safe integer range; scale or cast it in SQL before charting
issue.rowSelectorNoMatch: The selected group has no matching row in the current result
issue.rowSelectorNotUnique: The selected group matches several rows; the funnel cannot be determined uniquely
issue.nonMonotonicFunnel: This result is not a monotonic funnel; check the step definitions
issue.staleConfig: The chart configuration is no longer valid. Fell back to the table; the saved configuration was not overwritten
issue.staleConfigColumns: The chart configuration is no longer valid: {{columns}}. Fell back to the table; the saved configuration was not overwritten
issue.unsupportedConfigVersion: Unsupported chart configuration version; fell back to the table
issue.renderError: Chart failed to render. The raw table is still available.
issue.truncatedResult: The chart is based on the first {{rows}} rows returned and does not represent the full result
issue.recommendationUpgrade: A new automatic recommendation is available; it replaces the current chart only after you confirm

recommend.ambiguous: Cannot reliably tell whether “{{name}}” is a dimension or a metric
recommend.noUnique: No single reliable default chart; fell back to the detail table
recommend.singleRowMetrics: Detected {{count}} numeric metrics on a single row
recommend.lineWithSeries: Detected 1 date column, 1 series dimension and 1 numeric metric
recommend.line: Detected 1 date column and {{count}} numeric metrics
recommend.bar: Detected 1 category dimension and {{count}} numeric metrics
recommend.pivot: Too many categories; a pivot table fits better — filter the data to chart it

proposal.funnelStepColumn: Funnel step is missing a column
proposal.funnelStepLabelTooLong: Funnel step label is too long
proposal.noColumns: No result columns yet; run the SQL first
proposal.lineNeedsX: Line and trend charts need a time axis (x)

proposal.incompatible: The chart bindings are incompatible with the current columns

page.noCard: No card bound; saving creates a new card in the card library
page.timeRangeHint: The time range is always applied; defaults to the past 7 days (excluding today); pick the last N days or a static range; 90 days at most
page.builderRequired: Configure the grouping in the Builder panel and click “Generate SQL” first
page.proposalExpired: The proposal has expired; ask the AI to send it again
page.proposalStale: The editor content changed; ask the AI to read the page again
page.proposalOld: The AI proposal was based on an older version of the SQL and was rejected; ask the AI to read the page again.
page.cardAckFailed: The card is open on this page but no server acknowledgement arrived; ask the AI to read the page again.
page.editApplied: The AI proposal was written to the editor automatically; the AI must request execution to run it.
page.editAckFailed: The SQL was written on this page but no server acknowledgement arrived. Check the editor, reconnect and let the AI read the latest state.
page.noResult: No query result yet; run the SQL first
page.chartNoResult: The AI wants to fill in chart fields, but this page has no query result yet.
page.chartApplied: The AI filled in the chart field settings
page.chartAckFailed: The chart fields were written on this page but no server acknowledgement arrived. Ask the AI to read the page again.
page.executeMismatch: The execution request is not the current SQL in the editor
page.executeMismatchWarning: The SQL the AI asked to run differs from the editor content; the request was rejected.
page.executeAckFailed: The query has finished and the result stays on this page, but the server acknowledgement failed. Ask the AI to read the result again instead of running it twice.
page.sqlGenerated: The SQL was generated and written to the editor; edit it if needed and click Run

card.saveHint: After saving, find it in the “Analysis cards” library; the “Saved reports” dropdown no longer appears.
card.name: Card name
card.saved: Card saved; find it in the card library
card.descriptionPlaceholder: What this card measures and how it is calculated; shown when hovering the name in the card list
card.openedCached: Opened card “{{name}}” with the cached result
card.openedWithChart: Opened card “{{name}}”; change the view in settings or click Run
card.openedPlain: Opened card “{{name}}”; click Run to query

builder.sqlTooltipLine1: Write ClickHouse SQL by hand with full freedom: WHERE filters, arbitrary GROUP BY groupings and any combination of aggregate functions (the same grouping power as the Builder, but more flexible — you just write GROUP BY yourself).
builder.sqlTooltipLine2: Click an entry in the data dictionary on the left to insert event filters and property expressions quickly.
builder.tooltipLine1: No SQL needed: pick events, time granularity, property groupings and metrics in the “Group by” panel at the bottom left, then click “Generate SQL” to build a grouped query with GROUP BY and write it into the editor (it switches to SQL mode so you can keep editing) — good for routine grouped statistics.
builder.tooltipLine2: SQL mode supports the same grouping and aggregation, and stays more flexible.
